# Inference Process

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InferenceProcess`](gmeow-InferenceProcess.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InferenceProcess>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The occurrent reasoning episode — inference as it unfolds in time, drawing a conclusion from premises. The perdurant face of inference: a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md) borne by exactly one [`gmeow:experiencer`](../properties/gmeow-experiencer.md) and carrying [`gmeow:mentalProcessType`](../properties/gmeow-mentalProcessType.md) [`gmeow:processReasoning`](../individuals/gmeow-processReasoning.md), the reparenting hook the mentation slice reserves. It [`gmeow:producesMentalMoment`](../properties/gmeow-producesMentalMoment.md) the belief it creates and reaches its argument structure via [`gmeow:hasInferenceCommitment`](../properties/gmeow-hasInferenceCommitment.md). Distinct from the endurant [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) (the argument relation it instantiates) — keeping the [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) endurant/occurrent split clean.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InferenceProcess`](gmeow-InferenceProcess.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Abduction

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example — ABDUCTION (inference to the best explanation), the FULL CHAIN.
#
# This example exercises all three fidelity tiers and the endurant/occurrent
# split end to end:
#
#   gmeow:InferenceProcess  --hasInferenceCommitment-->  gmeow:InferenceCommitment
#       (the occurrent reasoning episode)                  (the endurant argument)
#            |                                                   |
#       producesMentalMoment                               conclusion
#            v                                                   v
#       the accepted belief        is the agent's attitude    gmeow:StandpointClaim
#       (gmeow:MentalMoment)        toward the winning ------> (the conclusion content)
#                                   hypothesis
#
# A clinician observes a fever and reasons to its best explanation. Two
# candidate hypotheses compete (gmeow:competesWith); each is scored by a
# solver-layer gmeow:explanatoryScore (Principle 12 — there is no isBest bit).
# The winner's modality is promoted gmeow:conceivable -> gmeow:probable; the
# loser is SUPPRESSED (gmeow:displayable false), never deleted (Principle 10).

# --- The occurrent reasoning episode (perdurant) ---------------------------- #
ex:diagnosticReasoning a gmeow:InferenceProcess ;
    rdfs:label "The clinician's diagnostic reasoning episode"@en ;
    gmeow:experiencer ex:clinician ;                          # functional: one episode, one reasoner
    gmeow:mentalProcessType gmeow:processReasoning ;          # the canonical occurrent marker (no eventTypeInference)
    gmeow:eventTime "2026-06-15T10:05:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:eventTemporalFrame gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian ;
    gmeow:hasInferenceCommitment ex:abductiveCommitment ;     # occurrent -> endurant bridge
    gmeow:producesMentalMoment ex:beliefInfluenza .           # production: reasoning creates this new belief (a MentalMoment)
```

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- The occurrent kind of an inference is recorded as [`gmeow:mentalProcessType`](../properties/gmeow-mentalProcessType.md) [`gmeow:processReasoning`](../individuals/gmeow-processReasoning.md), NOT as a dedicated [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) value: an 'eventTypeInference' individual was deliberately NOT minted ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4) — one canonical source), since [`processReasoning`](../individuals/gmeow-processReasoning.md) already names this occurrent fact on the mentation spine.
